pages.title: Heart of the Heatland
pages.text: As tall as a Titan Tree, with a crater and a lava lake on top. Lava rivers spread from it.

pages.title: Rivers and tunnels
pages.text: Lava rivers run from the crater downhill, branch out and sometimes harden into black stone. Follow one upstream to find the volcano.$(br2)Inside are a magma chamber and lava tunnels that sometimes open onto the slope.$(br2)$(#B04A1F)Tip:$() the $(l:heatland/phoenix)Phoenix$(/l) circles above the crater. Lava forgives no mistakes: $(item)Icy Touch$() cools it, but only for a while, and it heats up again.
